messages:
SRE Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert P-4231 fired -> private-agent-heartbeat missing (customer: AcmeCorp, vpc: vpc-12ab). Severity: P1. Paging eng-oncall.
PagerDuty: Page sent to Maya S., Jared K., on-call rotation.
Maya S.: ack. Jumping in — I'll triage control plane connectivity first. @AcmeCorp CS notified.
Jared K.: on network. Pulling flow logs and checking peering status. Can someone confirm which agent image? last reported 1.2.3.
Priya R.: grabbing agent logs from control plane side. If heartbeat missing, could be reverse-tunnel down. Will check NAT mappings and agent manager.
Maya S.: Confirmed private deployment (customer-managed VPC). This is the on-prem agent (edge-agent-01) that handles control plane websocket to our private control plane endpoint.
SRE Incident Bot: PagerDuty: Maya S. acknowledged at 1793501240.
Jared K.: seeing RSTs from agent IP 203.0.113.42 to controlplane.redwood-inference.net:443. Flow logs show session teardown ~1793501200. No peering tear. Investigating NAT gateway logs.
Priya R.: control plane shows agent disconnected; last seen: 2024-12-03T18:05Z. Reconnect attempts failing with TLS handshake timeout. Dumping agent logs:

```
2024-12-03T18:04:58Z WARN reconnect attempt 3 -> dial tcp 34.82.10.11:443: i/o timeout
2024-12-03T18:05:01Z ERROR heartbeat missed 1
```

Maya S.: quick mitigation idea — route this customer's requests to hosted fallback for now (we have agreement for transient failover). Priya, can we flip fallback for their account? It will increase cost but reduces immediate customer impact.
Priya R.: yes, I can toggle fallback route. Making change in the routing control plane now.
Alex T.: I'll open a Jira and include customer impact, timeline, and mitigation steps: INC-9876. Assigning to eng-infra for nat/gw review.
SRE Incident Bot: Routing toggle executed by Priya R. — fallback enabled for AcmeCorp at 1793501320.
Maya S.: Customer impact: API calls to their private endpoint are failing; public fallback is serving ~60% of traffic (some clients pinned to private). CS says high priority for their payments flow. We need ETA for agent restore.
Jared K.: NAT gateway shows aggressive port timeout (idle timeout 120s) — looks like the NAT mapping for the agent's outbound websocket expired and agent didn't reconnect. Could be long-lived idle keepalive missing after recent sysadmin change on their side.
Priya R.: I can attempt an active reconnect via control plane proxied push — will send a push to agent to re-initiate handshake.
Maya S.: go for it. Also ask CS for any maintenance on customer firewall.
Priya R.: push sent. Agent responded with SYN at 1793501402. TLS handshake completes. Agent re-registered and heartbeat restored.
SRE Incident Bot: Agent edge-agent-01 reconnected at 1793501410. Heartbeats resumed.
Maya S.: confirming health: control plane metrics show 1.2.3 agent stable, last_heartbeat now 5s. Rolling status to green for control plane to customer.
Alex T.: Updated INC-9876 with timeline, root cause hypothesis (customer NAT idle timeout / missing keepalive), and mitigation (fallback + control plane push). Assigned follow-up to infra and solutions engineering.
Jared K.: action items: add a safety keepalive on agent side or detect NAT expiry and proactively reconnect; infra to document NAT guidance for private deployments.
Maya S.: handing off to on-call infra (Jared) for post-incident remediation and postmortem. I'll run RCA notes tomorrow and coordinate with CS for customer post-incident summary. Thanks all :heart:
Alex T.: ETA for postmortem doc: EOD tomorrow. I'll include suggested config snippets and an action tracker.
Maya S.: closing pager. Final status: resolved — agent reconnected, fallback handled traffic, no data loss reported. Will run follow-up with AcmeCorp tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
